guardrails.title: Work only in your addon repository
guardrails.rule: Work only in this repository. Kassis core is a dependency, never a file to edit.

guardrails.title: Import only from the SDK and your own code
guardrails.rule: Import only from @kassis/* packages and your own src/. Never resolve host services by name.

guardrails.title: Choose the lowest rung
guardrails.rule: Choose the lowest rung: configuration first, a declarative addon second, code last. State the rung you chose and why in the change summary.

guardrails.title: Declare permissions and audit every write
guardrails.rule: Every route declares a permission in your addon namespace. Every write goes through ctx.data or a host facade and records an audit action declared in the manifest.

guardrails.title: Give every event a schema and handle missing capabilities
guardrails.rule: Every published event has a schema. Every consumed capability handles null, because the addon that provides it can be switched off.

guardrails.title: Make every migration reversible
guardrails.rule: Every migration has a down script, or is marked irreversible with a reason.

guardrails.title: Declare any widened access
guardrails.rule: Never widen permissions, egress hosts or data access without saying so in the change summary.

guardrails.title: Pass certify before you finish
guardrails.rule: Run kassis addon certify before you say you are done, and fix every error.

guardrails.title: Document what you built
guardrails.rule: Document what you built in README.md and CHANGELOG.md.

guardrails.title: Do not refactor code you were not asked to change
guardrails.rule: Do not refactor code you were not asked to change.

guardrails.title: Read your pinned guardrails and attest to them
guardrails.rule: At the start, read the guardrails and skills of your pinned profile (kassis adk sync). Before you say you are done, fill in .kassis/attestation.json with one answer per guardrail.
